items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: I knew Sal and all that bunch in his band and usually when they come in here to play here we all go out to Frank's house after the job

ctx.x: I don't believe well he was there last month he was there when Hackett was downtown I met some of the guys out of his band

uh huh well I knew Sal and all that bunch in his band and usually when they come in here to play here we all go out to Frank's house after the job Frank Horne's house we'd have a little coffee session and what not sit around talk play tapes and uh Charlie used to quiz me about some of the old timers he'd get a big kick out of me
what about Leo Addy did you ever know him?
